name: Terraforming Mars
description: Corporations race to make Mars livable for 1–5: raise heat, oxygen and oceans, build cities and greenery, and play project cards.

intro: **Built from the official rulebook** by FryxGames (the 2016 English edition, published in the US by Stronghold Games), linked from the [FryxGames Terraforming Mars page](https://fryxgames.se/product/terraforming-mars/).
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages. Icons are described in words, so check the page image for those. Tap any page image to see it as printed.
This covers the base game. Expansions such as **Prelude**, **Colonies** and **Turmoil** have their own rulebooks on the FryxGames site.
